title: Environmental Protection Act 1996 (Act No. 11 of 1996), Chapter 20:05
citation: Act No. 11 of 1996; Cap. 20:05 (amended by Act No. 17 of 2005)
evidence: Section 1 of the Act as passed: "This Act may be cited as the Environmental Protection Act 1996 and shall come into operation on such date as the Minister may by order appoint." Opened https://www.parliament.gov.gy/documents/acts/6032-11_of_1996_environmental_protection_act_1996.pdf on 2026-11-03. No official page states the commencement date, so in_force is null. The commencement order was not found on an official page.
notes: Environmental framework act (the register row carried F7; mapped to F2: it requires environmental authorisation and assessment for activities with adverse effects, and sets up the Environmental Protection Agency). The Act as passed (Parliament PDF, text layer) and the revised text with Act No. 17 of 2005 (MOLA, https://mola.gov.gy/laws/Volume%206%20Cap.%2018.01%20-%2023.011696964321.pdf) were opened. Regulations under it: gy-epa-water-quality-regs-2000, gy-epa-hazardous-waste-regs-2000, gy-epa-noise-regs-2000, gy-epa-air-quality-regs-2000, gy-epa-authorisation-regs-2000. No record: both rows are permission requested (Crown copyright, no reuse terms). English is the language of legislation; no translation needed.

title: Local Content Act 2021 (Act No. 18 of 2021)
citation: Act No. 18 of 2021 (Official Gazette Legal Supplement A, 31 December 2021)
evidence: Section 1: "This Act may be cited as the Local Content Act 2021." The Act has no commencement clause (read on the scanned page 126 of the Gazette Legal Supplement dated 31 December 2021; the arrangement of sections lists no commencement section). The Parliament order paper https://www.parliament.gov.gy/documents/order-papers/23506-51st_order_paper.pdf says the Act was assented to on 31 December 2021. No official page states the commencement date, so in_force is null. Opened https://www.parliament.gov.gy/documents/acts/22943-act_no._18_of_2021.pdf on 2026-11-03.
notes: Local content obligations on persons in petroleum operations (contractors under the Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Act, Cap. 65:04) with local content plans and reports; the brief expected reporting duties on petroleum-sector companies. It is not a climate or emissions disclosure law; it is kept because the brief named it. The PDF is a scanned image (pdftotext returns page headers only; no OCR tool was installable), read by eye. No record: row GY-PARLIAMENT-ADOPTED is permission requested.
